SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.paid_amount), 0) AS paid,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(SUM(p.paid_amount), 0) >= o.amount THEN 'paid'
        WHEN COALESCE(SUM(p.paid_amount), 0) > 0 THEN 'partial'
        ELSE 'unpaid'
    END AS payment_status
FROM {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
LEFT JOIN {{ source('legacy', 'payments') }} p
    ON p.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.amount

explanation: This procedure builds a payment status report with one row per order. For each order, it adds up all payments recorded against it, treating orders with no payments as zero paid. It then labels each order "paid" if payments cover the order amount, "partial" if some money has been paid but not enough, and "unpaid" otherwise.
